subject: stmtctx: remove OverflowAsWarning flag (#49122)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent in scope (executor/expression/sessionctx/table). Core change is removing `StmtCtx.OverflowAsWarning` and routing overflow/out-of-range handling through truncate semantics: `errno.ErrDataOutOfRange` is grouped under truncate in `pkg/errctx/context.go`, call sites switch from `HandleOverflow` to `HandleError`/`HandleErrorWithAlias` (e.g. `pkg/expression/builtin_cast.go`), and pushdown flags couple `FlagOverflowAsWarning` with `TruncateAsWarning` in `pkg/sessionctx/stmtctx/stmtctx.go` + `ResetContextOfStmt` no longer sets the removed flag (`pkg/executor/executor.go`). No remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantic risks found; later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up fix specific to this overflow-as-warning removal beyond unrelated refactors.
